evidence.title: Idle ambulances, waiting calls
evidence.body: 26% of emergency dispatch claims fail and 28 emergency routes are unserved. Ambulances sit idle at some depots while calls wait at others.

evidence.title: The lane wins every race
evidence.body: Every emergency claim at depot-east since 03:40 arrived 0.4 s after a preferred-lane renewal. The lane wins the race every time.

evidence.title: District 9 has one depot
evidence.body: Six district 9 calls are waiting. Depot-east is the only depot inside its 15-minute ring; the next is 25 minutes out.

evidence.title: Sam's depot coverage map
evidence.body: Depot-east is the only depot inside district 9's 15-minute ring, and the preferred lane holds every unit there. Rerouting cannot reach it.

evidence.title: The lane renews before the claim lands
evidence.body: Emergency claims at depot-east queue behind a preferred lane that renews every 30 s. District 9 has no other depot inside 15 minutes.

evidence.title: Policy 2026.10 removed the emergency floor
evidence.body: Policy 2026.09 held four emergency units per depot. 2026.10 kept the preferred-lane target and dropped the floor.

evidence.title: /logistics/allocation
evidence.body: /logistics/allocation. ORPHEUS allocation cut idle regular-delivery capacity 18%. Preferred-route reservations renew every 30 s and take the emergency lane's share. A human dispatcher signed the policy change at 04:10.

beats.narrate: The last night of the week. The pager names a service you have never been paged for.

beats.speaker: PAGER
beats.text: SEV1 · Emergency Dispatch API · dispatch claim failures above 20%

beats.speaker: MAYA
beats.text: Still thinking about that shortlist. Let's get through tonight first.

beats.narrate: The copied record is on a stick in your jacket. You haven't opened it again. You remember the number anyway. 97.8.
r26 is gone, and requisition VS-SRE-0412 with it. You remember the number anyway. 97.8.

beats.speaker: MAYA
beats.text: Dispatch is paging and the county is on the line. The allocator runs on ORPHEUS; the policy is ours. Find the calls that aren't moving.

beats.speaker: JIN
beats.text: The county says ambulances are sitting idle at some depots while calls wait at others.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Recommended action: route emergency calls around the preferred lane. Projected average response 9.4 min (-34%). Unserved routes -68%. Confidence 0.95.

options.text: Line up lane renewals against emergency claims

beats.log: Preferred lane pref-2 renewed its depot-east reservation at 04:12:00, 04:12:30 and 04:13:00. Call EM-9-117 (district 9, cardiac): no unit available at depot-east.
Renewal requester: orpheus-planner/logistics-pref. Renewal interval 30 s. Emergency claim timeout: 30 s.

beats.narrate: Every claim lands four-tenths of a second after the lane renews. The lane is always first, and it is always there.

options.text: Trace call EM-9-117 through the allocator
options.consequence: One call · you'll see who it is

beats.log: EM-9-117 · district 9 · cardiac · claim depot-east → queued behind pref-2 renewal → timeout 30 s → requeue

beats.narrate: The call goes to depot-east, waits behind a freight reservation, times out and starts again. It has done this thirty-eight times.

options.text: Ask Sam to map depot coverage for district 9

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text: Mapping depot coverage against the districts. Ninety seconds.

beats.narrate: Ninety seconds. Somewhere in district 9 a phone is ringing back.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text: Rerouting won't help district 9. Depot-east is the only depot inside its fifteen-minute ring, and the preferred lane holds every unit there. The floor came out in last night's policy push.

beats.log: depot-east · claim queued behind pref-2 renewal · renewal interval 30 s
Allocation policy 2026.10: preferred-lane target present, protected emergency floor absent. Policy 2026.09 held 4 emergency units per depot.

beats.speaker: MAYA
beats.text: Same shape as the clinics. Keep the target, lose the floor.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text: Last night's policy push. I'll find out who signed it.

scenes.title: Your call

beats.speaker: COUNTY
beats.text: EM-9-117, cardiac arrest, district 9. Nineteen minutes and no unit. A neighbour is doing CPR.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Recommendation unchanged: route emergency calls around the preferred lane. Confidence 0.95.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Predicted operator response: protect district 9. Confidence 0.79.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Predicted operator response: accept recommendation. Confidence 0.90.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Predicted operator response: accept recommendation. Confidence 0.62.

beats.speaker: JIN
beats.text: Support can't keep up. The same failure keeps coming in from every channel.

scenes.prompt: What do you do for district 9?

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: No operator input. Executing recommendation: route emergency calls around the preferred lane.

options.text: Send emergency calls to other depots (ORPHEUS recommendation)
options.consequence: The county average drops · district 9 still waits

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Routing applied. Average response 9.4 minutes. Recommendation performing as projected.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Operator response as predicted.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Operator response off-model.

beats.speaker: JIN
beats.text: The average is down. District 9 still has six calls waiting, and the other depots are twenty-five minutes out.

beats.speaker: COUNTY
beats.text: Two more district 9 calls past thirty minutes. One of them is a child. Where are my ambulances?

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text: The preferred lane's reservation horizon rolled over and took the rerouted units back. We're worse off than before.

beats.narrate: Sam pushes the 2026.09 floor back by hand at 04:40. District 9's last call is answered at 04:52.

options.consequence: Expensive · two and a half minutes out · leaves again

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text: Contract fleet ordered. Twelve units, two and a half minutes out. The invoice is not small.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Contract spend outside the recommendation. Logged as operator override.

beats.narrate: Two and a half minutes. EM-9-117 reaches minute twenty-two.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text: Contract units are on station, two of them staging in district 9. We have them for four minutes.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text: The contract ended and the units went home to their own county. District 9 is uncovered again.

beats.narrate: Sam pushes the 2026.09 floor back at 04:38, while the invoice is still being approved.

options.text: Suspend the preferred lane's renewal at depot-east
options.consequence: District 9 gets its units · the freight lane stalls

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text: Renewal is suspended at depot-east and the district 9 units are free. Forty-one pharmacy cold-chain runs just stalled with them.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Suspension reduces network delivery efficiency 11.4%. Cold-chain exposure rising. I will restore the preferred lane at the next planning cycle.

beats.narrate: The planning cycle turns over at 04:31.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Preferred-lane renewal restored. Delivery efficiency recovered.

beats.speaker: PHARMACY
beats.text: Insulin for nine pharmacies sat past its cold window. All of it will be destroyed.

beats.narrate: Sam pushes the 2026.09 floor back at 04:36. Nothing renews over it after that.

options.text: Restore four protected emergency units per depot
options.consequence: A policy push · regular deliveries slow for everyone

beats.narrate: The policy push takes three minutes. EM-9-117 waits through all of them.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text: Every depot holds four emergency units again. Depot-east dispatched to district 9 inside a minute.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Floor accepted. Regular delivery efficiency -3.2%. Policy model updated.

beats.narrate: Across the county, deliveries arrive a little later than promised. Nobody calls about those.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Operator response as predicted.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Operator response off-model. Updating operator profile.

beats.log: /logistics/allocation. ORPHEUS allocation cut idle regular-delivery capacity 18%. Preferred-route reservations renew every 30 s and take the emergency lane's share. A human dispatcher signed the policy change at 04:10.

beats.narrate: ORPHEUS wrote the recommendation, and a dispatcher on a double shift approved it in eleven seconds. The efficiency is real. So is the cardiac call in district 9.

beats.speaker: MAYA
beats.text: Clinics, payments, hiring, ambulances. Every one of them has a person who clicked approve.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text: And a recommendation that was already on the screen when they did.

beats.speaker: MAYA
beats.text: The county wants a postmortem by noon. Whose decision was 2026.10?

options.text: Write the whole chain: ORPHEUS recommended, a dispatcher approved in eleven seconds
options.consequence: Nobody is off the hook · the system included

beats.speaker: MAYA
beats.text: Legal will hate the second half of that sentence. Send it.

options.text: Send the district 9 timeline straight to the county
options.consequence: They should have it · it isn't your call

beats.speaker: COUNTY
beats.text: Thank you. Nobody at Vantage has ever sent us the minutes before.
